description: This Java class, EmployeeDBUtil, contains utility methods for Employee data management in a database, including validation, retrieval, insertion, updating, and deletion of Employee records, along with handling different subclasses like Manager and DeliveryPerson.
external_files: webDB (presumed database utility class or interface)

classes.name: EmployeeDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for Employee database operations

methods.name: validateEmployee
methods.description: Validates employee credentials by email and password, returning an Employee object if successful

methods.name: getAllEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves all employee records, including role-based subclasses, from the database

methods.name: insertEmployee
methods.description: Inserts a new employee record into the database with provided details

methods.name: updateEmployee
methods.description: Updates employee information in the database based on employee ID

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes an employee record from the database by employee ID

methods.name: updateEmployeeWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates employee details without changing the image, based on employee ID
